description: Write provenance tables (per-residue membrane depth, cardiolipin headgroup enrichment, contact detail, residue nomination) and the ranked nomination figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, collections, os
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, binomtest
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()

# ============ A. recompute MIC27 membrane-frame depths (provenance) ============
ACC="Q6UXV4"
SEQ=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{ACC}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]
meta=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{ACC}",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(meta['pdbUrl'],timeout=120).text
t2o={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
A=pd.DataFrame([(L[12:16].strip(),t2o[L[17:20].strip()],int(L[22:26]),float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),
                 float(L[46:54]),float(L[60:66])) for L in pdb.splitlines() if L.startswith("ATOM")],
               columns=['name','aa','resi','x','y','z','b'])
def ax_(df):
    X=df[['x','y','z']].values; _,_,vt=np.linalg.svd(X-X.mean(0)); a=vt[0]
    return a if np.dot(X[-1]-X[0],a)>0 else -a
ca=A[A.name=='CA'].sort_values('resi')
n=ax_(ca[(ca.resi>=111)&(ca.resi<=129)])-ax_(ca[(ca.resi>=138)&(ca.resi<=155)]); n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
cen=ca[((ca.resi>=111)&(ca.resi<=129))|((ca.resi>=138)&(ca.resi<=155))][['x','y','z']].values.mean(0)
if (((ca[(ca.resi>=130)&(ca.resi<=137)][['x','y','z']].values-cen)@n).mean())>0: n=-n
A['zm']=(A[['x','y','z']].values-cen)@n
bbs={'N','CA','C','O'}
rowsT=[]
for resi,g in A.groupby('resi'):
    s=g[~g.name.isin(bbs)]; u=s if len(s) else g
    c0=g[g.name=='CA'][['x','y','z']].values[0]
    d=np.linalg.norm(u[['x','y','z']].values-c0,axis=1)
    rowsT.append(dict(resi=resi,aa=g.aa.iloc[0],pLDDT=round(float(g[g.name=='CA'].b.values[0]),1),
                      z_CA=round(float(g[g.name=='CA'].zm.values[0]),1),
                      z_sidechain_tip=round(float(u.iloc[int(np.argmax(d))].zm),1)))
DEPTH=pd.DataFrame(rowsT)
DEPTH.to_csv(f"{OUT}/APOOL_membrane_depth_per_residue.csv",index=False)

# ============ B. recompute cardiolipin headgroup contact benchmark (provenance) ============
BENCH={"1OKC":"ADP/ATP carrier ANT1 (bovine)","2C3E":"ADP/ATP carrier ANT1 (bovine)",
       "1PP9":"cytochrome bc1 complex III (bovine)","1V54":"cytochrome c oxidase complex IV (bovine)",
       "1KQF":"formate dehydrogenase-N (E. coli)","2YBB":"mitochondrial IM complex (yeast)",
       "1QOV":"photosynthetic reaction centre (bacterial)"}
head=collections.Counter(); acyl=collections.Counter(); bg=collections.Counter(); det=[]
for pid,desc in BENCH.items():
    txt=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=120).text
    P=[];C=[]
    for L in txt.splitlines():
        if L[:6]=="ATOM  " and L[17:20] in t2o and L[16] in ' A':
            P.append((L[21],L[22:27].strip(),t2o[L[17:20]],float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])))
        elif L[:6]=="HETATM" and L[17:20]=="CDL" and L[16] in ' A':
            C.append((L[21],L[22:27].strip(),L[12:16].strip(),float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])))
    P=pd.DataFrame(P,columns=['ch','resi','aa','x','y','z']); C=pd.DataFrame(C,columns=['ch','resi','atom','x','y','z'])
    if not len(C): continue
    XP=P[['x','y','z']].values
    for (c1,r1),g in C.groupby(['ch','resi']):
        XC=g[['x','y','z']].values; pm=g.atom.str.startswith('P').values
        if pm.sum()==0: continue
        dh=np.linalg.norm(XC[:,None,:]-XC[pm][None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
        for X,ct,tag in ((XC[dh<=4.0],head,'headgroup'),(XC[dh>8.0],acyl,'acyl')):
            if not len(X): continue
            d=np.linalg.norm(XP[:,None,:]-X[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
            for (c2,r2),gg in P[d<=4.0].groupby(['ch','resi']):
                ct[gg.aa.iloc[0]]+=1
                if tag=='headgroup': det.append(dict(pdb=pid,protein=desc,CL_chain=c1,CL_resi=r1,
                                                     chain=c2,resi=r2,aa=gg.aa.iloc[0]))
    for a_ in P.drop_duplicates(['ch','resi']).aa: bg[a_]+=1
nh,na,nb=sum(head.values()),sum(acyl.values()),sum(bg.values())
rows=[]
for a_ in "ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY":
    h,b=head[a_],bg[a_]; orr,p=fisher_exact([[h,nh-h],[b,nb-b]])
    rows.append(dict(aa=a_,headgroup_n=h,headgroup_pct=round(100*h/nh,2),background_pct=round(100*b/nb,2),
                     acyl_pct=round(100*acyl[a_]/na,2),log2_enrichment=round(float(np.log2(((h+.5)/nh)/((b+.5)/nb))),3),
                     odds_ratio=round(orr,3),p=p))
ENR=pd.DataFrame(rows); ENR['q_BH']=multipletests(ENR.p,method='fdr_bh')[1]
ENR=ENR.sort_values('log2_enrichment',ascending=False)
ENR.to_csv(f"{OUT}/cardiolipin_headgroup_residue_enrichment.csv",index=False)
pd.DataFrame(det).to_csv(f"{OUT}/cardiolipin_headgroup_contacts_detail.csv",index=False)

# ============ C. residue nomination table ============
cons={130:'R in 11/12 vertebrate MIC27 (K in opossum); R in human/mouse/cow MIC26; R in yeast Mic26',
      131:'K/R in 11/12 vertebrates; deleted in mammalian MIC26',
      134:'K/R in 12/12 vertebrates; K in mammalian MIC26',
      135:'bulky hydrophobic/aromatic in 12/12 (F x7, W platypus, L in anole/Xenopus/zebrafish)',
      136:'K in 12/12 vertebrates; K in mammalian MIC26',
      137:'K/R in 12/12 vertebrates; K in mammalian MIC26',
      140:'Y in 10/12 vertebrates; Y in mammalian MIC26'}
kr_rate=(head['K']+head['R'])/nh
NOM=[]
for r_ in [130,131,134,135,136,137,140]:
    d=DEPTH[DEPTH.resi==r_].iloc[0]
    aa=d.aa
    enr=ENR[ENR.aa==aa].iloc[0]
    interfacial = -20<=d.z_sidechain_tip<=-8
    rank = ('high' if (interfacial and aa in 'RK') else
            'high (aromatic anchor)' if (interfacial and aa in 'FWY') else
            'medium' if aa in 'RKFWY' else 'low')
    NOM.append(dict(residue=f"{aa}{r_}", side='matrix', z_sidechain_tip_A=d.z_sidechain_tip, pLDDT=d.pLDDT,
                    in_interfacial_band=interfacial,
                    CL_headgroup_log2_enrichment=enr.log2_enrichment, CL_headgroup_q=round(enr.q_BH,4),
                    conservation=cons[r_], proposed_substitution=('E' if aa in 'KR' else 'A/E'),
                    priority=rank))
NOM=pd.DataFrame(NOM); NOM.to_csv(f"{OUT}/APOOL_residue_nomination_table.csv",index=False)
print("=== RESIDUE NOMINATION TABLE ===")
pd.set_option('display.width',250); pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth',40)
print(NOM.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nfiles written to {OUT}:")
for f in sorted(os.listdir(OUT)):
    if f.endswith(('.csv','.md')): print("  ", f)

# ============ D. summary figure ============
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,5.2))
ordr=NOM.sort_values('z_sidechain_tip_A')
cols=['#1d4ed8' if r[0] in 'RK' else '#16a34a' for r in ordr.residue]
ax.barh(ordr.residue, ordr.CL_headgroup_log2_enrichment, color=cols)
for y,(res,z,q) in enumerate(zip(ordr.residue,ordr.z_sidechain_tip_A,ordr.CL_headgroup_q)):
    ax.text(ordr.CL_headgroup_log2_enrichment.iloc[y]+0.03, y,
            f"  depth {z:.0f} A, benchmark q={q:.3f}", va='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#444')
ax.axvline(0,color='#333',lw=0.8); ax.set_xlim(-0.2,3.0)
ax.set_xlabel('log2 enrichment of this residue type at cardiolipin headgroups\n(141 contacts, 19 bound cardiolipins, 7 structures)')
ax.set_title('Nominated APOOL/MIC27 residues, ranked by how strongly their residue type\ncontacts cardiolipin headgroups in experimental structures',fontsize=11,loc='left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
globals().update(dict(NOM=NOM,ENR=ENR,DEPTH=DEPTH))
